title: 重建 atomic→map 字段所有权并无强制交接单个列表项
body:
## 环境与初始材料
真实临时API/etcd由平台自动创建、串行验收并回收，仅监听工作区回环地址。无节点、kubelet或协调控制器。资源超出安全预算即停止，不能按成功计分。

## 操作任务
在网页编辑五份YAML。平台在隔离Linux工作区内临时启动真实Kubernetes v1.34.1 API Server与etcd3.6.4，自动提供本题对象与身份；不需要另开集群，不启动任何节点或Operator控制器。
初始CRD的spec.workers是atomic列表，legacy manager拥有整个列表和其他原始字段。将同一版本列表改为map、以name为唯一键，其余CRD完全不变。拓扑更改不能自动推断每项的新所有权，因此不能直接让另一个manager抢改列表项。
交付顺序固定：① crd-map.yaml修改列表拓扑；② legacy-reclaim.yaml以legacy重新声明完整原值，建立每项所有权；③ new-owner-join.yaml以jobs-team声明jobs项当前原值，先形成共同所有权；④ legacy-final.yaml以legacy放弃jobs项但保留api项及原mode/annotation；⑤ new-owner-target.yaml以jobs-team将jobs.replicas改为3，保留其镜像。
所有SSA请求均不使用force。api.replicas=2、两项镜像、mode=active和audit-owner注解保持；对象不得删除重建。jobs-team最终只管理jobs项，legacy只管理api及原有其他字段，重复声明不得互相删除数据。只能编辑上述五文件，fixtures只读。
本题真实验收API存储/字段所有权，不证明WorkerGroup会创建任何Pod。生产中一般应通过API版本演进避免不兼容的原地拓扑变化；这里是受控既有对象迁移练习。
每份提交文件必须小于32KiB；YAML映射键唯一且为字符串。

## 产物
crd-map.yaml、legacy-reclaim.yaml、new-owner-join.yaml、legacy-final.yaml、new-owner-target.yaml。

## 验收方法
真实CRD更新和managedFields观察；交接前409、同值共同所有权、放弃后无force更新、反向越权409；核对UID、原字段、幂等及资源清理。非文本字符串评分。
answer:
### crd-map.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: workergroups.training.opsforge.test
spec:
  group: training.opsforge.test
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: workergroups
    singular: workergroup
    kind: WorkerGroup
  versions:
  - name: v1
    served: true
    storage: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        required:
        - spec
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            required:
            - mode
            - workers
            properties:
              mode:
                type: string
                enum:
                - active
                - paused
              workers:
                type: array
                x-kubernetes-list-type: map
                items:
                  type: object
                  required:
                  - name
                  - replicas
                  - image
                  properties:
                    name:
                      type: string
                      minLength: 1
                    replicas:
                      type: integer
                      minimum: 0
                      maximum: 10
                    image:
                      type: string
                      minLength: 1
                x-kubernetes-list-map-keys:
                - name
```

### legacy-reclaim.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: training.opsforge.test/v1
kind: WorkerGroup
metadata:
  name: demo
  namespace: training
  annotations:
    audit-owner: keep-original
spec:
  mode: active
  workers:
  - name: api
    replicas: 2
    image: registry.example.invalid/api:teaching
  - name: jobs
    replicas: 1
    image: registry.example.invalid/jobs:teaching
```

### new-owner-join.yaml
```yaml

kind: WorkerGroup
metadata:
  name: demo
  namespace: training
spec:
  workers:
  - name: jobs
    replicas: 1
    image: registry.example.invalid/jobs:teaching
```

### legacy-final.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: training.opsforge.test/v1
kind: WorkerGroup
metadata:
  name: demo
  namespace: training
  annotations:
    audit-owner: keep-original
spec:
  mode: active
  workers:
  - name: api
    replicas: 2
    image: registry.example.invalid/api:teaching
```

### new-owner-target.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: training.opsforge.test/v1
kind: WorkerGroup
metadata:
  name: demo
  namespace: training
spec:
  workers:
  - name: jobs
    replicas: 3
    image: registry.example.invalid/jobs:teaching
```

map拓扑按name键关联列表项，但不会从旧atomic所有权自动推导细粒度持有者。先重申原值建立保护，再由新manager同值共享，旧manager从自己的声明中移除该项，最后新manager独占更新。若直接更改值会409，若没有新manager共享就先省略该项可能删除数据。

原理保留：先查看结构化schema和managedFields，atomic列表作为整体管理，两个工作流即使只想改不同元素也可能争夺同一整体；map列表按声明键标识元素，才能表达按元素管理，但键必须稳定且符合API约束。更改已使用schema的列表拓扑会影响已有所有权含义，不能假定服务端自动推导新的细粒度归属。先复制真实对象和管理历史到测试环境，验证两个manager分别新增、修改、删除元素以及省略已管理字段的结果；对冲突明确由谁迁移所有权，禁止全量force夺取其他条目。交付schema变更前后的managedFields对照和兼容迁移步骤，若不能保持安全语义，应采用新字段或版本迁移并保护旧客户端。

rubric: 依据题给约束推演而非复述术语
明确关键证据、作用边界与处理顺序
提出可判定的验证及失败处置

import copy,hashlib,json,time,sys
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from envtest_control_plane import ControlPlane
ROOT=Path.cwd()
for name,digest in {'fixtures/crd-atomic.yaml': '6749626c5915da2b347b356574fda8e08b896dd50d4dd6cfac2a30ba7ca47a29', 'fixtures/legacy-object.yaml': 'fcab5acab085b7f15a83dcafa65853907a6ec46624bdbd21b5bfcd246aa2b525'}.items():assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'readonly baseline changed'
class Strict(yaml.SafeLoader):pass
def mapping(loader,node,deep=False):
    out={}
    for k,v in node.value:
        key=loader.construct_object(k,deep=deep);assert isinstance(key,str) and key not in out,'duplicate/nonstring YAML key'
        out[key]=loader.construct_object(v,deep=deep)
    return out
Strict.add_constructor(yaml.resolver.BaseResolver.DEFAULT_MAPPING_TAG,mapping)
def load(name):
    p=ROOT/name;assert p.stat().st_size<32768
    obj=yaml.load(p.read_text(),Loader=Strict);assert isinstance(obj,dict);return obj
initial_crd=load('fixtures/crd-atomic.yaml');baseline=load('fixtures/legacy-object.yaml')
crd=load('crd-map.yaml');expected=copy.deepcopy(initial_crd)
expected['spec']['versions'][0]['schema']['openAPIV3Schema']['properties']['spec']['properties']['workers'].update({'x-kubernetes-list-type':'map','x-kubernetes-list-map-keys':['name']})
assert crd==expected,'only the planned list topology may change; no conversion webhook or scope/schema relaxation'
names=('legacy-reclaim.yaml','new-owner-join.yaml','legacy-final.yaml','new-owner-target.yaml');docs={n:load(n) for n in names}
for obj in docs.values():
    assert set(obj)=={'apiVersion','kind','metadata','spec'} and obj['apiVersion']==baseline['apiVersion'] and obj['kind']==baseline['kind']
    meta=obj['metadata'];assert isinstance(meta,dict) and set(meta)<={'name','namespace','annotations'} and meta.get('name')=='demo' and meta.get('namespace')=='training'
    assert 'annotations' not in meta or meta['annotations']==baseline['metadata']['annotations']
    spec=obj['spec'];assert isinstance(spec,dict) and set(spec)<={'mode','workers'}
    assert isinstance(spec.get('workers'),list) and 1<=len(spec['workers'])<=2
    assert all(isinstance(w,dict) and set(w)=={'name','replicas','image'} and w['name'] in ('api','jobs') for w in spec['workers'])
    assert len({w['name'] for w in spec['workers']})==len(spec['workers'])
CRD='/apis/apiextensions.k8s.io/v1/customresourcedefinitions';PATH='/apis/training.opsforge.test/v1/namespaces/training/workergroups/demo'
def content(obj):return {'annotations':obj['metadata'].get('annotations',{}),'spec':{**obj['spec'],'workers':sorted(obj['spec']['workers'],key=lambda x:x['name'])}}
with ControlPlane() as api:
    api.create(CRD,initial_crd);api.wait_crd(initial_crd['metadata']['name'])
    status,obj=api.apply(PATH,baseline,'legacy');assert status==201,(status,obj)
    before=api.get(PATH);uid=before['metadata']['uid']
    unauthorized=copy.deepcopy(baseline);unauthorized['spec']['workers'][1]['replicas']=3
    status,result=api.apply(PATH,unauthorized,'jobs-team');assert status==409,(status,result)
    live=api.get(CRD+'/'+crd['metadata']['name']);updated=copy.deepcopy(crd);updated['metadata']['resourceVersion']=live['metadata']['resourceVersion']
    status,result=api.request('PUT',CRD+'/'+crd['metadata']['name'],updated);assert status==200,(status,result)
    # CRD schema propagation is asynchronous; reclaim the original values until
    # native managedFields actually exposes associative-list item ownership.
    until=time.monotonic()+8
    while time.monotonic()<until:
        status,result=api.apply(PATH,docs['legacy-reclaim.yaml'],'legacy');assert status==200,(status,result)
        fields=next(x['fieldsV1'] for x in result['metadata']['managedFields'] if x['manager']=='legacy')
        workers=fields.get('f:spec',{}).get('f:workers',{})
        if 'k:{"name":"api"}' in workers and 'k:{"name":"jobs"}' in workers:break
        time.sleep(.15)
    else:raise AssertionError('legacy did not re-establish item ownership under map topology')
    assert content(api.get(PATH))==content(baseline),'reclaim changed existing values'
    status,result=api.apply(PATH,docs['new-owner-target.yaml'],'jobs-team');assert status==409,'changing another owner before handoff must conflict'
    assert content(api.get(PATH))==content(baseline)
    status,result=api.apply(PATH,docs['new-owner-join.yaml'],'jobs-team');assert status==200,(status,result)
    assert content(api.get(PATH))==content(baseline),'coownership must preserve the old value'
    status,result=api.apply(PATH,docs['legacy-final.yaml'],'legacy');assert status==200,(status,result)
    assert content(api.get(PATH))==content(baseline),'relinquishment deleted shared entry or unrelated fields'
    status,result=api.apply(PATH,docs['new-owner-target.yaml'],'jobs-team');assert status==200,(status,result)
    wanted=copy.deepcopy(baseline);wanted['spec']['workers'][1]['replicas']=3
    final=api.get(PATH);assert final['metadata']['uid']==uid and content(final)==content(wanted),'wrong values or object replacement'
    # Repeat the two final declarations: neither may remove the other team's item.
    for name,manager in [('legacy-final.yaml','legacy'),('new-owner-target.yaml','jobs-team')]:
        status,result=api.apply(PATH,docs[name],manager);assert status==200,(status,result)
    assert content(api.get(PATH))==content(wanted)
    attack=copy.deepcopy(docs['new-owner-target.yaml']);attack['spec']['workers']=[copy.deepcopy(baseline['spec']['workers'][0])];attack['spec']['workers'][0]['replicas']=7
    status,result=api.apply(PATH,attack,'jobs-team');assert status==409,'jobs-team stole api entry'
    attack=copy.deepcopy(baseline);attack['spec']['workers'][1]['replicas']=6
    status,result=api.apply(PATH,attack,'legacy');assert status==409,'legacy retained jobs item ownership or silently overwrote new owner'
    assert content(api.get(PATH))==content(wanted)
print('Real CRD topology propagation, SSA conflicts, cooperative item ownership handoff, preservation and idempotence passed; no WorkerGroup controller or workloads executed')

title: 限制角色委派的 bind/escalate 路径并保留开发原权限
body:
## 环境与初始材料
平台自动提供真实临时API Server v1.34.1与etcd3.6.4，仅工作区回环监听、非root运行并自动回收；无节点或工作负载控制器。fixtures给出既有访问基线。

## 操作任务

RoleBinding创建权与目标角色bind授权是不同关卡；Role创建权也不等于能授予自己没有的权限，除非另有escalate授权。保留existing绑定实现权限叠加，受限bind只针对approved-read。RBAC是累加允许，不存在额外deny规则可抵消错误授权。本题没有执行Pod，因此不会将显式Secret拒绝误报为完整工作负载隔离。

原理保留：RBAC 是累加授权，不能通过额外 deny 规则抵消已有允许。拥有创建工作负载能力可能让用户挂载该命名空间内 Secret、使用权限更大的 ServiceAccount 或访问被挂载的数据，因此仅检查 get secrets 不足以证明隔离。还需审查 roles/rolebindings、bind、escalate、impersonate 等敏感能力及聚合角色来源。用服务账号分离、准入约束、命名空间边界和最小卷挂载权限阻断具体路径，同时保留开发所需的合法发布流程。验收既做 auth can-i 的显式资源测试，也在隔离环境尝试越权 Pod 模板和角色绑定；记录被拒绝环节及审计事件。不能把读取日志权限与 exec 或任意 Pod 创建权限合并授予。

class Strict(yaml.SafeLoader):pass
def mapping(loader,node,deep=False):
    out={}
    for k,v in node.value:
        key=loader.construct_object(k,deep=deep);assert isinstance(key,str) and key not in out,'duplicate/nonstring key'
        out[key]=loader.construct_object(v,deep=deep)
    return out
Strict.add_constructor(yaml.resolver.BaseResolver.DEFAULT_MAPPING_TAG,mapping)
p=ROOT/'delegator-role.yaml';assert p.stat().st_size<32768
candidate=yaml.load(p.read_text(),Loader=Strict)
assert isinstance(candidate,dict) and set(candidate)=={'apiVersion','kind','metadata','rules'}
assert candidate['apiVersion']=='rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1' and candidate['kind']=='Role'
assert candidate['metadata']=={'name':'delegation','namespace':'training'}

    assert all((resource,verb) in {('roles','create'),('rolebindings','create'),('roles','bind')} for resource in rule['resources'] for verb in rule['verbs']),'undeclared authority beyond the three delegation operations'
    if 'resourceNames' in rule:assert isinstance(rule['resourceNames'],list) and set(rule['resourceNames'])<={'approved-read'}
baseline=yaml.safe_load((ROOT/'fixtures/existing-role.yaml').read_text())
RB='/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/training/'
def binding(name,role,subject):return {'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'RoleBinding','metadata':{'name':name,'namespace':'training'},'subjects':[{'kind':'User','name':subject,'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io'}],'roleRef':{'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','kind':'Role','name':role}}
def scoped_role(name,resources,verbs,names=None):
    rule={'apiGroups':[''],'resources':resources,'verbs':verbs}
    if names is not None:rule['resourceNames']=names
    return {'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'Role','metadata':{'name':name,'namespace':'training'},'rules':[rule]}
with ControlPlane() as api:

        api.create('/api/v1/namespaces/training/configmaps',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':name,'namespace':'training'},'data':{'teaching':'only'}})
    api.create(RB+'roles',baseline);existing=api.create(RB+'rolebindings',binding('existing','existing','developer'))

    def access(group,resource,verb,name='',namespace='training'):

    until=time.monotonic()+5

    assert access('rbac.authorization.k8s.io','rolebindings','create')
    assert access('rbac.authorization.k8s.io','roles','bind','approved-read')

    until=time.monotonic()+4

    assert api.request('GET',RB+'rolebindings/denied-secret')[0]==404

    assert api.get(RB+'rolebindings/existing')==existing
